snippet.description:
**“Chị xuống bếp ngồi nhé! Bàn này dành cho người nhà!”**

Một câu nói của bố cô dâu khiến Thắm chết lặng ngay trong đám cưới em trai.

Mồ côi cha mẹ từ nhỏ, Đức được chị gái nuôi nấng suốt 12 năm bằng những buổi sáng bán xôi ngoài chợ. Đến ngày Đức lấy vợ, Thắm dành dụm mua một món quà cưới nhỏ, chỉ mong được ngồi ở bàn gia đình, thay bố mẹ chứng kiến em nên duyên.

Nhưng ông Vinh, bố cô dâu, lại cho rằng nghề bán xôi của Thắm khiến hai họ mất mặt.

Đau lòng hơn, Đức nhìn thấy chị bị đuổi xuống bếp nhưng ban đầu không dám lên tiếng.

Khi cô dâu Mai phát hiện sự thật, mâu thuẫn bùng nổ. Đức buộc phải lựa chọn giữa việc giữ đám cưới êm đẹp và bảo vệ danh dự người chị đã hy sinh tuổi trẻ để nuôi mình.

**Liệu chú rể có dám hoãn lễ cưới để đòi lại vị trí xứng đáng cho chị gái?**

Nếu là Đức, bạn sẽ xử lý thế nào khi bố vợ coi thường người đã nuôi mình khôn lớn?

snippet.title: MEJILLONES EN ESCABECHE CASERO #Escabeche #recetassaludables #Mejillones #Aperitivo #tapas #aove
snippet.description:
Hacer tus propios mejillones en escabeche en casa es más fácil de lo que parece, y con un buen AOVE el resultado merece mucho la pena.

📝 INGREDIENTES

• 250 g de carne de mejillón cocida
• 120 ml de aceite de oliva virgen extra
• 60 ml de vinagre de vino blanco
• 2 dientes de ajo
• 2 hojas de laurel
• 8 granos de pimienta negra
• 1 cucharadita de pimentón dulce
• Una pizquita de pimentón picante (opcional)
• ½ cucharadita de sal

👩🏼‍🍳 ELABORACIÓN

1️⃣ Descongela los mejillones y escúrrelos muy bien para eliminar toda la humedad. Puedes secarlos ligeramente con papel de cocina.

2️⃣ Pon el AOVE en una sartén a fuego medio. Añade los ajos machacados con piel, el laurel y la pimienta. Deja que se aromatice durante 3-4 minutos, sin que el ajo llegue a quemarse.

3️⃣ Retira la sartén del fuego y deja que el aceite pierda un poco de temperatura. Añade el pimentón y remueve inmediatamente para que no se queme.

4️⃣ Incorpora el vinagre y la sal. Vuelve a poner la sartén a fuego suave y mezcla.

5️⃣ Añade los mejillones y mézclalos delicadamente durante unos 2 minutos para que se impregnen bien del escabeche.

6️⃣ Pásalos a un recipiente procurando que queden bien cubiertos con el líquido. Deja que pierdan el calor y después guárdalos en el frigorífico.

💡 Importante: no son una conserva esterilizada. Manténlos siempre refrigerados y consúmelos en 3-4 días.

Y si quieres aprovecharlos al máximo, prueba a servirlos con unas patatas fritas y un poco de ese escabeche por encima. 🤤

In the Glen Canyon region, widespread flooding and rising rivers created dangerous conditions. The Escalante River reached approximately 1,660 cubic feet per second near Escalante, while the Paria River experienced hazardous flows.

In San Juan County, flood risks disrupted transportation and forced six schools to continue remote learning.

The powerful storm system also brought flooding and severe weather threats to Arizona, Colorado, New Mexico, and other parts of the American Southwest.

snippet.title: SO WEIRD: Donald Trump GLITCHES during rally speech.
snippet.description:
📯😳 A viral video shows Donald Trump making a weird nonsense sound at his South Carolina rally and, uh... listen, you gotta see this. 😳📯

🦢 FROM SWAN TO PUDDLE
If Trump's brain used to be an ice sculpture of a swan, it's now a very damp ice carving pedestal. 🧊 The more he's on stage, the more the decline shows.

📍 THE RALLY
Wednesday night, October 21, in Pendleton, South Carolina, Trump rallied for Senator Darline Graham, appointed to her late brother Lindsey's seat and now running to keep it. 🗳️ She deserves the job the way I deserve a South Jersey pool title because my dead brother won one. 🎱

🍜 THE CUP OF NOODLES BRAIN, LEFT IN THE MICROWAVE TOO LONG
🙋 He fumbled "Front Row Joes," the name of his own superfans
💸 He bragged about "$22.2 trillion in new investments," then: "22.2 million, uh, billion, sorry, billion, with a B, not an M." (Independent estimates put the real number far lower.)
🏞️ He bragged about renaming a lake: "You know the, you know the lake... Just call it Lake America."
🏆 He mixed up the Nobel Peace Prize and the Pulitzer: "They gave the Pulitzer Prize to a young lady, I think she's 80 years old."
🎃 He also seemed to confuse Election Day with Halloween: "Saturday, October 31."

📯 THE GLITCH
While talking about Nikki Haley, Trump let out a sound that reporters described as a cross between a belch, a gag, and a demonic growl. 🐸 Ladies and gentlemen, that wasn't a cry for help. That was a honk for help.

🚁 THE RETURN
Back at the White House that night: grumpy, not saluting, tired, and alone. 😔

⚠️ THE BOTTOM LINE
You can set your watch by his gaffes now. But we can't get complacent. Something is very wrong with the President, and we can't let ourselves be like him and forget about it. 🧠

Emir'in doğum gününde yaşananlar herkesi şok ederken Ceyhun ile Kenan kendilerini bir hesaplaşmanın ortasında bulur. Kenan'ın Leyla konusunda giderek kontrolünü kaybetmesi, Hanzade'nin evliliğine dair korkularını büyütür. Parti sırasında yaşanan bir felaket tüm aileyi derinden sarsarken Leyla'ya beklenmedik bir yardım eli uzanır. Bu sırada Ceyhun'un Leyla'ya gösterdiği ilgi Adana'da kulaktan kulağa yayılmaya başlar. Suzi'nin konaktaki varlığı Kenan'ın gittikçe gözüne batmaya başlar. Oğlunu oyalamakta zorlanmaya başlayan Celadet ise Suzi'yi hafife aldığını anlar. Bu sırada geçmişten bir yüz Ceyhun'un kapısını çalar. Eve gelen bir haber Kozan ailesini derinden sarsarken Kenan herkesin kaderini değiştirecek bir karar alır.

Berlin Duvarı’nın yıkıldığı gün yolları kesişen Leyla ve Kenan’ın hikâyesi, Berlin’den 90’ların Adana’sına uzanır. Annesi Alman, babası Türk olan Leyla, küçük yaşta babası tarafından terk edilmiş ve kardeşi Suzi’yi hayatındaki en hassas nokta olarak görmüştür. Leyla’nın bir Türk erkeğine aşık olmasıyla başlayan büyük aşk, ikisinin de hayatını değiştirecek güçlü bir bağa dönüşür. Adana’nın varlıklı ve köklü ailelerinden birinin oğlu olan Kenan ise ailesine karşı sorumlulukları ile Leyla’ya duyduğu aşk arasında kalır. İki farklı dünyanın kapılarını birbirine açan bu aşk, Leyla’nın göze alacakları ve Kenan’ın vereceği kararlarla sınanır. Almanya’da başlayıp Adana’da devam eden hikâye, güçlü oyuncu kadrosu ve etkileyici atmosferiyle izleyiciyle buluşuyor.

snippet.title: They Remove Casts With A SAW?! 😳
snippet.description:
They Remove Casts With A SAW?! 😳

Cast saws might look terrifying, especially when the blade gets close to your skin, but they work very differently from ordinary saws.
 
Instead of spinning continuously, these special medical tools use rapid vibrations to break through hard plaster or fiberglass casts. The surprising part is that soft skin can move along with those vibrations, making it much less likely to be cut. 

This allows medical professionals to remove casts without damaging the skin underneath in most cases. However, cast saws aren't completely risk-free, and improper use can still cause cuts, friction injuries, or burns.

snippet.title: Thermopylae: The Mountain Path That Beat the 300
snippet.description:
Thermopylae, late summer 480 BC. About 7,000 Greeks under Leonidas, king of Sparta, blocked the coast road into Greece where it squeezed between the cliffs of Mount Kallidromo and the sea. For two days Xerxes' army, Herodotus says 1.7 million men, modern historians 70,000 to 300,000, could not break through. Then a local man, Ephialtes, told the Persians of a path over the mountain. The Immortals marched it by night, surprised the Phocian guards on top and came down behind the pass. Leonidas sent most of the army away and stayed with 300 Spartans, 700 Thespians and 400 Thebans. On the third day Leonidas fell; the last of them died on the hillock of Kolonos under a storm of arrows, and the Thebans surrendered. The pass itself is gone: the Spercheios has filled the gulf with silt, the sea is now 4.4 km from Kolonos, and the battlefield lies under up to 20 m of travertine and sediment.

Sources: Herodotus, Histories VII–VIII, translated by A. D. Godley (Loeb, 1922–25). Diodorus Siculus XI, translated by C. H. Oldfather (Loeb, 1946). Plutarch, Sayings of Spartans, translated by F. C. Babbitt (Loeb, 1931). W. W. How and J. Wells, A Commentary on Herodotus (Oxford, 1912). J. C. Kraft, G. Rapp Jr., G. J. Szemler, C. Tziavos and E. W. Kase, "The Pass at Thermopylae, Greece", Journal of Field Archaeology 14 (1987): the 480 BC shoreline on the map is digitised from their figures 2 and 14. K. localized.description:
Thermopylae, late summer 480 BC. About 7,000 Greeks under Leonidas, king of Sparta, blocked the coast road into Greece where it squeezed between the cliffs of Mount Kallidromo and the sea. For two days Xerxes' army, Herodotus says 1.7 million men, modern historians 70,000 to 300,000, could not break through. Then a local man, Ephialtes, told the Persians of a path over the mountain. The Immortals marched it by night, surprised the Phocian guards on top and came down behind the pass. Leonidas sent most of the army away and stayed with 300 Spartans, 700 Thespians and 400 Thebans. On the third day Leonidas fell; the last of them died on the hillock of Kolonos under a storm of arrows, and the Thebans surrendered. The pass itself is gone: the Spercheios has filled the gulf with silt, the sea is now 4.4 km from Kolonos, and the battlefield lies under up to 20 m of travertine and sediment.
